label: Hematopoietic stem/progenitor regulation in bone marrow
reason: All members concern HSC homeostasis, proliferation, differentiation and survival in the bone-marrow niche.

label: MYC-driven ribosome biogenesis and translation initiation
reason: Pol I/III rRNA/tRNA transcription and rRNA processing plus cap-dependent translation initiation, linked as MYC-driven protein-synthesis capacity; few odd members (heterochromatin, TFAP2A).

label: DNA repair, deamination and antibody diversification
reason: BER/NER/MMR/TLS repair dominate, linked specifically to AID/APOBEC deamination, somatic hypermutation, V(D)J and TET/TDG demethylation via shared repair machinery.

label: Gonad development and reproductive endocrinology
reason: Gonadotropin/activin/AMH signalling, sex determination, folliculogenesis, ovulation, luteinisation and germ-cell meiosis form one reproductive axis.

label: Lymphocyte antigen-receptor signalling and activation
reason: TCR/BCR downstream signalling (PKC, ITK, NF-kB, second messengers, IL-2) and lymphocyte activation throughout.

label: Myelination and axon-glia nodal organisation
reason: Myelin formation/maintenance, paranodal junctions, Na channel clustering via neurofascin/L1/ankyrin, oligodendrocyte and glial biology.

label: Branched-chain amino acid catabolism and organic acidemias
reason: BCKDH/MSUD, leucine/valine/isoleucine catabolism, carboxylase/biotin deficiencies and related organic acidurias; few minor extras.

label: Synapse assembly and postsynaptic receptor clustering
reason: Neurexin/neuroligin-driven excitatory and inhibitory postsynaptic assembly, PSD-95/gephyrin and receptor clustering.

label: Ubiquitin-proteasome protein degradation
reason: Ubiquitin chain types, E3 ligases, degron pathways, deubiquitinases and proteasome regulation; CCT/folding terms are a small minority.

label: Antiviral innate sensing and type I interferon
reason: TLR7/8/9/3, RIG-I/MDA5, cGAS-STING, IRF3/7 activation, IFN production/response and ISGs; few peripheral apoptosis terms.

label: Lung branching morphogenesis and epithelial-mesenchymal signalling
reason: Lung/trachea development, pneumocyte differentiation and branching via epithelial-mesenchymal crosstalk; salivary/palate/limb bud share the same mechanism.

label: Regulation of proteasomal protein degradation
reason: All members concern ubiquitin-dependent or -independent proteasomal catabolism and its regulation.

label: Peroxisome biogenesis and peroxisomal lipid metabolism
reason: Peroxisomal protein import/fission plus VLCFA, plasmalogen/ether lipid and PUFA metabolism carried out in peroxisomes.

label: Monoamine neurotransmitter synthesis and degradation
reason: Catecholamine and serotonin biosynthesis, MAO/COMT degradation, uptake, and sympathoadrenal development.

label: Myelopoiesis and granulocyte differentiation
reason: Myeloid progenitor, granulocyte/neutrophil/eosinophil/mast cell differentiation, CSF signalling and promyelocyte BTMs.

label: Immune response, innate and adaptive
reason: Very large immune cluster spanning TLR/inflammasome innate sensing, T helper/B cell/NK adaptive biology and cytokine signalling, linked by the immune system; a few odd terms.

label: Apoptosis and necroptosis signalling
reason: Intrinsic BCL-2/MOMP, extrinsic death receptor/caspase-8, apoptosome, execution phase and RIPK-mediated necroptosis.

label: Non-coding RNA modification
reason: rRNA/tRNA/snRNA methylation and pseudouridylation via snoRNPs.

label: Neutrophil antimicrobial effector functions
reason: Degranulation, respiratory burst/ROS, phagocyte killing of bacteria and fungi; mucus secretion is a minor outlier.

label: Eicosanoid synthesis and receptor signalling
reason: COX/PLA2 prostaglandin and leukotriene synthesis, prostanoid/leukotriene GPCRs, fever; GPCR BTMs fit.

label: Hedgehog signalling and morphogen lipidation
reason: Hh processing, SMO and GLI regulation plus Wnt ligand palmitoylation/secretion, linked by cysteine palmitoylation of secreted morphogens (HHAT, PORCN).

label: Circadian clock and metabolic regulation
reason: BMAL1/CLOCK, REV-ERB/ROR and heme signalling linked to PGC-1alpha/PPARA control of mitochondrial biogenesis, gluconeogenesis and thermogenesis.

label: Phosphoinositide synthesis and ER membrane contacts
reason: PIP/IP synthesis linked to ER tubular network organisation and non-vesicular lipid transfer at membrane contact sites.

label: Lipoprotein metabolism and cholesterol homeostasis
reason: Chylomicron/VLDL/LDL/HDL assembly, remodelling and clearance, cholesterol efflux, SREBP/LXR regulation, ABC transporter defects.

label: cAMP/PKA second-messenger signalling
reason: Adenylate cyclase activation, cAMP synthesis/degradation, PKA, CREB and DARPP-32 events.

label: Cardiac muscle calcium handling and contractility
reason: SR calcium uptake/release regulation controlling cardiac contraction force, relaxation and heart rate.

label: Cardiac action potential and conduction
reason: Phases of cardiac myocyte action potential, atrial/ventricular de/repolarisation and conduction system signalling.

label: Muscle sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling
reason: Ryanodine receptor release, SERCA uptake, NCX extrusion, T-tubules and calcium-dependent cardiac/skeletal contraction.

label: Golgi organisation and Rab-mediated trafficking
reason: Rab GEF/GAP/geranylgeranylation, vesicle tethering and Golgi ribbon disassembly/reassembly.

label: Replication stress and PARP-mediated DNA damage response
reason: Fork reversal, R-loops, topological change, poly-ADP-ribosylation and responses to replication-blocking genotoxins.

label: Myeloid phagocyte antimicrobial inflammatory response
reason: Neutrophil degranulation, respiratory burst, complement receptor and macrophage/monocyte killing of microbes.

label: Appetite and energy-balance hormonal control
reason: Leptin and ghrelin signalling, feeding behaviour, appetite and nutrient-level responses and growth.

label: Endosomal TLR and cGAS-STING nucleic-acid sensing
reason: TLR7/8/9 regulation, SLC15A4-TASL-IRF5, TREX1 and cGAS/STING control with IFN-beta output.

label: Amino acid and organic acid catabolism, glycine conjugation
reason: Glycine/threonine/proline/glyoxylate metabolism and mitochondrial glycine/glutamine conjugation of aromatic acids; many broad parent terms.

label: Embryonic axial patterning, Hox and somitogenesis
reason: Hox clusters, somite segmentation, hindbrain rhombomeres, neural plate and limb patterning along body axes.

label: Dendritic spine and postsynaptic structural plasticity
reason: Spine morphogenesis, postsynaptic actin, dendrite arborisation, synaptic plasticity and NMDAR-RAC1 signalling.

label: Dopamine receptor signalling and reward behaviour
reason: D1/D2 receptor signalling, DARPP-32, and behavioural responses to cocaine, amphetamine, nicotine and conditioning.

label: Amino sugar and nucleotide-sugar metabolism and transport
reason: UDP-GlcNAc and sialic acid synthesis, SLC35 nucleotide-sugar transporters and related CDG defects.

label: Basal transcription by RNA polymerases I, II, III
reason: Initiation, promoter escape, elongation/pausing and termination of Pol I/II/III including HIV Tat/P-TEFb elongation; few rRNA processing extras.

label: Nuclear envelope remodelling and ESCRT abscission
reason: Mitotic NE disassembly and reformation, lamina depolymerisation and ESCRT-III sealing and midbody abscission.
